RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.

Death of a Rumanian Jew at the Red Rose Cafe,
Cabaret, No. 125 Jukeng Road, Chapel.

At 6 a.m. on the 29-12-36, the undersigned, with
the assistance of the French Police, again visited
Passage 9, House 6, Route de Grouchy, but Jean Bartolomeu
was absent, and it was learned he had not visited there
since the morning of the 27-12-36, date on which S.
Wiesgarten was murdered.

Between 10 a.m. and 3 p.m. on the 29-12-36,
D.S. Barton kept observation on the house, but Jean
Bartolomeu failed to put in an appearance.

Between 7 p.m. and 12 midnight on the 29-12-36,
the undersigned and D.S. Barton, with the assistance of
the French Police, visited the Auditorium, and brothels
and bars on the Avenue Joffre and Route Des Soeurs, when
it was learned Jean Bartolomeu had not been seen for
four or five days, prior to which he had resorted to
these places.

On the 30-12-36, a description of Jean Bartolomeu
was circulated by teleprinter for information of all
foreign detectives, stating he was wanted for questioning;
no results accrued from this. Passenger departments of
shipping companies were also warned.

The undersigned has visited cabarets in the
Settlement, French Concession and North Szechuen Road
area, seeking for information, this resulted in one
named Mr. Riberio, a Portuguese subject, being met at

1936年12月29日上午6时，具名者在法国警察的协助下，再次前往格罗希路（Route de Grouchy）6弄9号，但让·巴托洛梅乌（Jean Bartolomeu）不在，据悉自1936年12月27日早晨（即S. Wiesgarten被谋杀之日）起，他未曾去过该处。

1936年12月29日上午10时至下午3时之间，警佐巴顿（D.S. Barton）对该房屋进行监视，但让·巴托洛梅乌未现身。

1936年12月29日晚上7时至午夜12时之间，具名者与警佐巴顿在法国警察的协助下，走访了奥德翁剧院（Auditorium）以及霞飞路（Avenue Joffre）和修女院路（Route Des Soeurs）上的妓院和酒吧，获悉让·巴托洛梅乌已有四五天未被人看见，而在此之前他常去这些地方。

1936年12月30日，通过电传打字机向所有外籍侦探分发关于让·巴托洛梅乌的外貌描述以供参考，称其因需接受问询而被通缉；此举未获结果。各轮船公司的客运部门也接到了警告。

具名者走访了公共租界、法租界及北四川路地区的夜总会以寻求线索，由此结识了一位名为里贝罗先生（Mr. Riberio）的葡萄牙籍人士，他在

11.30 p.m. on the 5-1-37, in the Red Rose Cafe, Jukong Road. He informed the undersigned that his friend one Mr. Dentici, an Italian subject, had met Bartolomeu on the 28-12-36. On request, Mr. Dentici and Mr. Riberie attended Dixwell Road Station on the morning of the 6-1-37, when Mr. Dentici gave the following information.

On the 28-12-36, he saw Jean Bartolomeu, at his home and office, Passage 1284, House 19, Rue Lafayette, when Bartolomeu informed him that he had had a quarrel with his paramour, and did not wish to sleep at his home, Passage 9, House 6, Route de Grouchy, that night, so asked Mr. Dentici if he could sleep in Mr. Dentici's office. This was permitted, and after leaving early the following morning, Bartolomeu, returned later when Mr. Dentici was out.

Mrs. Dentici, however, saw him, and she observed his demeanour was very nervous. At about 7.30 p.m. on the 29-12-36, Bartolomeu again visited Mr. Dentici, carrying a small valise, and told him that his paramour had given him $50.00 and a Chinese, name not mentioned, had also given him $50.00, this $100.00 he said was for his fare to Tientsin, where he had been promised a year's contract with the Grand Hotel, as an electrical fitter, at a salary of $130.00 per mensem. He further stated that he was leaving for Tientsin that evening by the 11 p.m. express train.

1937年1月5日晚上11时30分，在巨鹿路红玫瑰咖啡馆。他告知具名者，他的朋友一位名为登蒂奇先生（Mr. Dentici）的意大利籍人士，曾于1936年12月28日见过巴托洛梅乌。应要求，登蒂奇先生和里贝里先生（Mr. Riberie）于1937年1月6日上午前往狄思威路捕房，当时登蒂奇先生提供了以下信息。

1936年12月28日，他在拉斐德路（Rue Lafayette）19号1284弄的家中及办公室见到让·巴托洛梅乌，当时巴托洛梅乌告诉他，他与其情妇发生了争吵，当晚不愿睡在格罗希路6弄9号的家中，因此询问登蒂奇先生是否可以在其办公室过夜。获准后，巴托洛梅乌次日清晨早早离开，但在登蒂奇先生外出后又返回。

然而，登蒂奇夫人见到了他，并观察到他的举止非常紧张。1936年12月29日晚上约7时30分，巴托洛梅乌再次拜访登蒂奇先生，携带一个小提箱，并告诉他，他的情妇给了他50.00美元，还有一位未提及姓名的中国人也给了他50.00美元，他说这100.00美元是作为他去天津的路费，他在那里已获承诺在大饭店（Grand Hotel）担任电气装配工，签订一年合同，月薪130.00美元。他还表示，他将于当晚乘坐11点的特快列车前往天津。

    It would appear that Bartolomeu has left Shanghai,
but, in view of his divulging his destination, it would
not appear likely that he has gone to Tientsin.
    Mr. Dentici, who is a member of the Special Police,
of the French Concession, knew Bartolomeu when he was
employed in the armoury of the French Police, which
position he was dismissed from 18 months ago. He has
not had employment since.
    His paramour, Lydia Efremenko, Russian, employed at
Metropole Cabaret, residing Passage 9, House 6, Route de
Grouchy, was questioned by D.S. Barton and Detective
Ivanoff of the French Police, at 4.30 p.m. on the 6-1-37.
She stated, that at about 8 p.m. on the 28-12-36, she
quarrelled with Bartolomeu, over his relations with other
women, when she told him not to visit her again. He
left the house and she went to her work.
    At about 8 a.m. on the 29-12-36, he again visited
her, when she contends that she gave him an amount of
money in the region of $30.00 to $40.00, at that time he
appeared very upset, and said he was leaving Shanghai,
but did not give his destination.

    自那晚以后，登蒂奇先生再未见过他。
    看来巴托洛梅乌已离开上海，但是，鉴于他透露了目的地，他似乎不太可能去了天津。
    登蒂奇先生是法租界特别警察队的一员，他在巴托洛梅乌受雇于法国警察局军械库时便认识他，巴托洛梅乌于18个月前从该职位被解雇。此后他一直失业。
    他的情妇莉迪亚·叶夫列缅科（Lydia Efremenko），俄罗斯人，在大都会夜总会（Metropole Cabaret）工作，居住在格罗希路6弄9号，于1937年1月6日下午4时30分接受了警佐巴顿和法国警察伊万诺夫侦探（Detective Ivanoff）的问询。她陈述，1936年12月28日晚上约8时，她因巴托洛梅乌与其他女性的关系与他发生争吵，并告诉他不要再来看她。他离开了房子，她去上班了。

Dr. Wong Wha has been informed of the foregoing and stated he will notify the P.S. Bureau at Tientsin, for them to make enquiries.

The two coolies, namely Tsang Sz Ying (張士英) and Ts Ah Jing (朱阿勤), employed at the Red Rose Cafe, give the following description of the foreigner who entered the room shortly after 1 p.m. on the 27-12-36 and left about 3 p.m.

"Male foreigner, height about 5'5", medium build, long thin face, dark complexion, dark long hair, slight growth of beard and moustache, wearing a dark brownish coloured overcoat, and dark coloured soft hat."

This description is also given by the coolie Tsu Mim Kung (朱妙根), employed by Chen Chee (順泉) general store, 217 Woosung Road, referred to in the initial report.

This description tallies with that given by the French Police of Bartolomeu, prior to Mr. Dentici having seen him with his face and head shaven.

RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.

Death of a Rumanian Jew at the Red Rose
Cafe, Cabaret, 123 Jukong Road, Chapel.

The undersigned acting on the instructions of
the P.A. to D.C (Crime), at 9.30.a.m on the 28.12.36,
visited No. 123 Jukong Road, the Red Rose Cafe, to meet
Dr. Wong Wha, Officer i/c, 3rd Dept, P.S. Bureau Head-
quarters.

Dr. Wong Wha and party arrived at about 10.15.
a.m, prior to which the D.D.O."C" Division, visited the
scene.

In a bedroom on the 1st floor of the premises,
situated at the South East corner of the dance floor, on
a bed lay the body of Samuel Wiengarten, aged 77 years,
Rumanian Jew, manager of the Red Rose Cafe. The body
was lying on its left side, and had extensive burns on
the feet, hands and face. There were also two wounds
on the head. The bed clothing and mattress of the bed
was badly burnt. There was severe scorching of the wall
and wooden cupboard adjacent. The room was in a general
disorder, a broken bottle was lying among some debris
near the bed, and electric wiring hanging on the head
of the bed. A safe in the corner of the room had a
key in the lock.

At 10.30.a.m on the 28.12.36, Procurator Wang

inquest on the body, subsequent to Doctor Sung Kwei Peng's

| | 当时在一楼的几名舞厅俄罗斯和葡萄牙雇员来到 | | |
| | 舞厅并撞开了门。门上装有耶鲁弹簧锁。他们发现死者躺着的床正在燃烧，便用几桶水将其扑灭。 | | |
| | 直到1936年12月28日下午4时45分，才通知卫生局和北四川路捕房。 | | |
| | 舞厅的账簿显示圣诞节期间的收入约为 | | |
| | 900.00美元。A. 温加滕先生声称死者保险箱内约有2000.00美元—— | | |
| | 这笔钱以及死者身上的钱财已被盗走， | | |
| | 连同几张金额不明的支票。 | | |

The undersigned informed the bank of the alleged theft.

All the employees of the dance hall were taken to the P.S. Bureau Headquarters on the night of the 27.12.36 for questioning, they were released on the evening of the 28.12.36. Names of these individuals have not yet been obtained by the undersigned.

Until a late hour on the 28.12.36, no finger prints or definite clues at the scene of crime had been obtained by officers of the P.S.Bureau, however, everything points to murder and robbery.

Enquiries by the undersigned and D.S.I. Van Tuh Foo, results of which have been passed on to the D.D.O."C" Division, and Dr. Wong Wha, points to a foreigner being the culprit.

A coolie by the name of Tsu Miau Kung (朱妙根) employed by Chen Chee (順泉) general store, No. 217 Woosung Road, at about 2.30.p.m. on the 27.12.36, delivered an order of butter and wine to the deceased, in the room where he met his death. At that time a foreigner, whose description somewhat coincides with the description of a foreigner given by two coolies of the dance hall, in the P.S. Bureau Headquarters, who saw the foreigner entering the room shortly after 1.p.m. on the 27.12.36, and leaving about 3.p.m. the same day, was seen by this coolie in the room. | |

1936年12月27日晚，舞厅所有雇员均被带至警务处总部接受讯问，并于1936年12月28日晚获释。具名者尚未取得上述人员之姓名。

截至1936年12月28日深夜，警务处警官在犯罪现场仍未获取任何指纹或确切线索，然而，一切迹象均指向谋杀与抢劫。

经具名者及副督察长范图福（Van Tuh Foo，音译）查询，结果已转交“C”区副总监及黄华医生（Dr. Wong Wha，音译），结果显示罪犯系一名外国人。

1936年12月27日下午约2时30分，受雇于吴淞路217号顺泉（Chen Chee，音译）杂货店的苦力朱妙根（Tsu Miau Kung），向死者送交一批黄油和葡萄酒订单至其遇害的房间。当时，该苦力在房内看见一名外国人，其体貌特征与两名舞厅苦力在警务处总部所提供的描述大致吻合；这两名苦力曾看见该外国人于1936年12月27日下午1时许进入房间，并于同日下午3时许离开。 | |
